summary.text: Brent Jackson is a Republican member of the North Carolina State Senate who represents District 9 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.
He is the founder of Jackson Farming Company, an agricultural business.

paragraphs.text: Brent Jackson, whose full name is William Brent Jackson, was born in Clinton, North Carolina, in 1957, according to Wikipedia.
He founded Jackson Farming Company, which grows crops including watermelons, sweet potatoes, corn, wheat, soybeans and peanuts, and owns two country grain elevators and a liquid fertilizer plant.

The General Assembly's member page lists Jackson as a Republican senator for District 9, which covers Bladen, Duplin, Jones, Pender and Sampson counties, and says he has served eight terms in the Senate.
Wikipedia says he assumed office on January 1, 2011, representing the 10th District until 2023 and the 9th District since.

According to Wikipedia, he is co-chairman of the Senate Appropriations/Base Budget Committee and also sits on the Finance, Rules and Operations of the Senate, and State and Local Government committees.
